init.title: MGC Mower options
init.description: When the mower reports an event code this integration does not know yet, Home Assistant shows a notification once per code. It asks you to report the code with a screenshot of the app message, so it can be added for everyone.

data_description.notify_unknown_event_codes: Each unknown code is reported only once. Turn off if you do not want these notifications.

set_mowing_schedule.name: Set mowing schedule
set_mowing_schedule.description: Replace the weekly mowing schedule stored on the mower (same as the schedule in the R HOME app). Every entry repeats weekly. An empty list clears the schedule. Tested with MGC mowers (Redkey MGC1000).

entries.name: Entries
entries.description: List of schedule entries. Each entry has weekday (mon-sun) or weekdays (list), start (HH:MM), optional end (HH:MM, empty = until finished), cutter_height (30-70 mm in 5 mm steps) and direction (perpendicular, parallel or cross).

serial_number.description: Optional mower serial number or list of serial numbers.
